name: dsh-aliyun-coupon-api
description: 阿里云余额与代金券挂件（DeepSeek Harness 插件）：通过阿里云官方 OpenAPI 只读查询账户余额（QueryAccountBalance）与「云工开物」学生券剩余额度（DescribeCoupon），在侧边栏底部显示。无需账号密码，只需 RAM 只读 AccessKey。
author: tacotuesday22

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/signing.mjs && node tests/unit/usage.mjs && node tests/unit/normalize.mjs && node tests/unit/inject.mjs && node tests/unit/client-module.mjs && node tests/unit/settings-open.mjs && node tests/unit/readme.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node tests/integration/host-routes.mjs && node tests/integration/cache-freshness.mjs && node tests/integration/config-api.mjs
